title: Air Station Traverse City hoists injured snowmobiler from remote area near Chapleau Ontario in southern Canada
description: A helicopter crew from Coast Guard Air Station Traverse City, Mich., hoists an injured snowmobiler from a remote area near Chapleau, Ontario, in southern Canada, March 4, 2017. Snowmobilers who found the injured man on the trail traveled several miles to phone for emergency assistance and to provide a GPS location while others built a fire to keep the injured man warm until help arrived. (U.S. Coast Guard video)
